第56章 云川道士-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

郭云涛走后，吴姜的生活又恢复了往日的模样，依旧是混子般的日子，每天睡到自然醒，偶尔去老妈王雅琴那里蹭顿饭。

王雅琴见吴姜出去一趟，又带回了一百个W，对他也就懒得管了。

不知不觉间，十二月已经过了大半，天气越来越冷，吴姜更不想出门了。

这天是周末，吴姜没有去老妈那里蹭饭，难得兴起，自己在家里下厨，做了一桌子简单却可口的饭菜。

餐桌旁，吴姜和念念相对而坐，一大一小，吃得格外热闹。

自从郭云涛走后，吴姜就试验了一下朱宏教他的方法，没想到，居然真的可行。

念念虽然不能像正常人一样咀嚼吞咽饭菜，却能吸收饭菜中的精气，仅仅是这样，就已经让小丫头格外满足，每吸一口，眼睛就亮一分，小脸上满是幸福。

给念念做的饭，和吴姜的唯一区别，就是在饭菜中滴入了几滴用百年柳叶浸泡过的水。

吴姜找丧葬用品店的老刘一打听，就知道哪里有超过百年的柳树了。

中间去阮柏云家里吃饭的时候，还和念念的爷爷见了一面。

老爷子虽然心疼孙女变成现在这样，但看到念念给老爷子表演魔术，控制着遥控器在天上飞来飞去，眼里又多了几分欣慰，至少，偶尔还能见见宝贝孙女。

吃过饭，吴姜照常修炼了一会儿《幽冥炼魂诀》，加上这段时间接任务的奖励，他的境界已经无限接近鬼卒境后期，都快赶上朱宏这个百年老鬼了。

突破到鬼卒境后期，老祖宗传给他的《幽冥炼魂诀》里记载的那几道高级术法，也就达到修炼入门的标准了。

想到老祖宗，吴姜心里还有些怪想的。

只是，后来他又去了两次城隍庙，还是没有见到老祖宗，不知道老祖宗到底去了哪里。

就在吴姜运功完毕，准备起身的时候，手机突然响了起来。

吴姜看了一下，是赵安坤的电话，连忙接起。

“赵叔，怎么想起给我打电话了？”

“吴姜，明天有空吗？来我这里一趟，有件事想请你帮忙。”

After Guo Yuntao left, Wu Jiang's life returned to what it used to be. He was still living like a gangster, sleeping until he woke up naturally every day, and occasionally going to his mother Wang Yaqin's place for a meal.

Wang Yaqin saw that Wu Jiang went out and brought back another hundred W, so she didn't bother to care about him.

Unconsciously, more than half of December has passed, the weather is getting colder and colder, and Wu Jiang doesn't want to go out anymore.

It was the weekend, so Wu Jiang didn't go to his mother's place to have a meal. He rarely got up and cooked at home, making a table of simple but delicious meals.

At the dining table, Wu Jiang and Niannian sat opposite each other, one big and one small, eating very lively.

Since Guo Yuntao left, Wu Jiang tried the method Zhu Hong taught him. Unexpectedly, it actually worked.

Although Nian Nian couldn't chew and swallow the food like normal people, she could absorb the essence of the food. Just like this, the little girl was extremely satisfied. Every time she took a sip, her eyes lit up and her little face was filled with happiness.

The only difference between the meal cooked for Nian Nian and that of Wu Jiang was that a few drops of water soaked in century-old willow leaves were added to the meal.

Wu Jiang asked Old Liu of the funeral supplies store and found out where there was a willow tree that was more than a hundred years old.

When I went to Ruan Boyun's house for dinner, I also met Niannian's grandfather.

Although the old man felt sorry for his granddaughter to become like this, when he saw Nian Nian performing magic tricks for the old man and controlling the remote control to fly around in the sky, his eyes felt a little more relieved. At least, he could occasionally see his precious granddaughter.

After dinner, Wu Jiang practiced the "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique" for a while as usual. In addition to the rewards for accepting tasks during this period, his realm was infinitely close to the late stage of the Ghost Soldier Realm, and he was almost catching up with Zhu Hong, a century-old ghost.

After breaking through to the late stage of Ghost Soldier Realm, the advanced techniques recorded in the "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique" passed down to him by his ancestors have reached the standard for entry-level cultivation.

Thinking of his ancestors, Wu Jiang still had some strange thoughts in his heart.

However, he later went to the City God's Temple twice more, but still didn't see his ancestor, and he didn't know where his ancestor had gone.

Just when Wu Jiang finished his exercise and was about to get up, his cell phone suddenly rang.

Wu Jiang looked at it and saw that it was Zhao Ankun's call, and quickly picked it up.

"Uncle Zhao, why did you remember to call me?"

"Wu Jiang, are you free tomorrow? Come to my place. I need your help with something."
